_purpose: Records what worked, what failed, and what protocol changes are suggested. Lessons CANNOT silently modify the constitution. They accumulate here and feed the Protocol Evolution Workflow (Section 14).
what_worked: <specific practice or technique that contributed to a successful stage; cite stage or task>
what_failed: <specific stage, task, or sub-procedure that did not produce usable output; cite stage or task; describe the failure mode>

false_positives.instance: <what the protocol marked as BUYER_READY that should not have been>
false_positives.protocol_change_proposed: <if a protocol change is needed, name the section>

false_negatives.instance: <what the protocol rejected that should have passed>
false_negatives.protocol_change_proposed: <if a protocol change is needed, name the section>

prior_art_search_failures.source: PatSnap | EPO OPS | Google BigQuery | USPTO ODP | Lens.org
prior_art_search_failures.failure_substate: PERMISSION_ERROR | HTTP_ERROR | RATE_LIMIT | NO_RESULTS | SEARCH_INSUFFICIENT | SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
prior_art_search_failures.impact_on_gates: <which gates were affected by this failure>

engineering_assumptions_invalidated.invalidated_by: <simulation result, experimental data, or literature reference>
engineering_assumptions_invalidated.impact_on_engineering_gate: <how this affected the engineering gate score>

buyer_objections.objection: <what a hypothetical buyer (CTO/CSO/BD) would object to>

lessons_motivating: <list of evidence_ids that motivate this proposal>

_immutability_rules: Once written, this file may not be edited.
Appended entries are permitted (new lessons learned after-the-fact).
Existing entries may not be modified or deleted.
protocol_changes_proposed entries feed the Protocol Evolution Workflow but do NOT modify the constitution automatically.
V2 of the constitution is created only through the audit-approved workflow (Section 14).
